description: This file defines API endpoints for shopping cart operations in a FastAPI application, including retrieving, adding, updating, and removing cart items.

classes.name: CartResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the full cart response, including items and totals.

classes.name: CartItemCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new cart item, including product ID, quantity, and options.

classes.name: CartItemUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing cart item, primarily quantity.

classes.name: CartItemAddResponse
classes.description: Response schema returned after adding an item to the cart, including cart item ID.

classes.name: CartUpdateResponse
classes.description: Confirmation response schema after updating a cart item.

classes.name: CartDeleteResponse
classes.description: Confirmation response schema after deleting a cart item.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Customer model representing the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_cart( current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the current user's shopping cart and totals.

methods.name: add_to_cart( item: CartItemCreate, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to add an item to the shopping cart.

methods.name: update_cart_item( cart_id: int, update_data: CartItemUpdate, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to update the quantity of an existing cart item.

methods.name: remove_from_cart( cart_id: int, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to remove an item from the cart.

ctags.name: add_to_cart
ctags.signature: ( item: CartItemCreate, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: get_cart
ctags.signature: ( current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: remove_from_cart
ctags.signature: ( cart_id: int, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: update_cart_item
ctags.signature: ( cart_id: int, update_data: CartItemUpdate, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
